en: Welcome to Pal Park's gate! The park itself is far away in Sinnoh, but we can take you straight there.
Would you like to go to Pal Park?
Right this way, please. Mind the step!
{player} was shown through the gate on the long way to Pal Park...
Whenever you're ready. The park's Pokémon aren't going anywhere.
Pal Park is a place for Pokémon from far away. Only a Trainer with the National Pokédex may go through.
